latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — sales funnel design playbook for solopreneurs.

- Covers full funnel architecture from awareness to retention, tailored for solo businesses
- Provides two funnel models: self-serve (product-led) and high-touch (sales-led), with guidance on when to use each
- Details stage-by-stage tactics, customer mindset, and what moves leads forward
- Includes key conversion benchmarks at each funnel stage
- Offers troubleshooting advice for common funnel leaks and practical optimization tips
- Emphasizes the importance of automation for scalability without losing the personal touch when needed
